Hi all..

Suppose I get something with an effect in the Untap-phase (say an Army
of Rats) with the SuckClub, can I choose to use the effect, or do i
have to use it?

Thx,
Wouter

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You can use it.
If it is non-optional (like Army), then you must use it.
